integrity: An algebraic proof supports unbounded quantifiers; a standalone bounded verifier independently corroborates the recurrence, phase and periods. Historical novelty remains subject to incomplete specialized-literature coverage and no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only central Delannoy numbers, shifts divisible by four, and power-of-two moduli. No claim about higher dyadic layers for indices congruent to zero or three modulo four, or odd-prime periods. The first public source date records the earliest exactly dated directly inspected archival source, not first historical discovery.
title: Sharp dyadic index shifts and least periods of central Delannoy numbers
